content:
We’re getting together IRL!!

On Thursday, September 17th, Changelog is taking over PlanetScale’s HQ in San Francisco for an evening of short talks and conversations about AI, developer tools and what people are building. We’ll have a few conversations with special guests and time for questions, food, drinks and hanging out.

I’ll be joined by three builders pushing this idea forward, starting with Dan Robinson from Detail (detail.dev), with more guests to be announced very soon.

I also have 80 limited edition t-shirts printed to give away!

This won’t be a few presentations followed by everyone heading home. We’re doing this Changelog-style: live conversations, questions from the room, drinks, and plenty of time afterward for the hallway track.

If you’re in San Francisco, register to come hang out!

Changelog IRL

Thursday, September 17th, 2026
6:00pm – 9:00pm PDT

PlanetScale HQ
108 Natoma St, San Francisco, CA 94105

Speakers

  • Dan Robinson, (Detail)
  • Christian Glassiognon, Developer Educator at PlanetScale
  • TBD

Schedule

  • 6:00 - 6:45pm: Doors open, food, drinks and networking
  • 6:45 - 7:00pm: Welcome and opening chat with Adam
  • 7:00 - 8:00pm: Changelog IRL with Dan and special guests
  • 8:00 - 8:15pm: Questions
  • 8:30 - 9:00pm: Hanging out and networking
  • 9:00pm: Close

All times Pacific. PlanetScale HQ, 108 Natoma St, San Francisco.
